method: Operator and official destination addresses checked before modeling. Coordinates from those pages where published; otherwise the official address was geocoded against OpenStreetMap Nominatim and the returned named building checked. Buildings are artistically exaggerated at atlas scale.

landmarks.name: Oslo Opera House
landmarks.placement: Geographic root at real building; model grows east to reserve the journey arrival forecourt on its west.

landmarks.name: Stockholm City Hall
landmarks.placement: Geographic root on Kungsholmen. Building ensemble extends inland west from its waterfront tower.

landmarks.name: Copenhagen Nyhavn
landmarks.placement: Exaggerated ensemble grows west and south over Sjælland from its east-coast Copenhagen anchor; no arbitrary move to Jutland or Sweden.

landmarks.name: Gdańsk Żuraw
landmarks.placement: Real crane is on the Motława. Coastal illustration is shifted 0.07944 degrees north (about 8.8 km) toward the Baltic harbor at this exaggerated atlas scale. Historic crane and quays connect to the coast; they are not inland in central Poland.

landmarks.name: Warsaw Royal Castle
landmarks.placement: Real Castle Square coordinate; courtyard ensemble stays at Warsaw on the Vistula side of the old town.

landmarks.name: Tower Bridge
landmarks.placement: Real Thames crossing anchor. Bridge is aligned across a dedicated short illustrated Thames reach, well inside London; it is not moved to the outer English coast.

landmarks.name: Kinderdijk Nederwaard Museum Mill No. 2
landmarks.placement: Actual lowland polder windmill near Rotterdam, rather than a random northern coastal location.

landmarks.name: Bergen Bryggen
landmarks.placement: Official VisitBergen latitude/longitude metadata; merchant gables line the Vågen waterfront.

landmarks.name: Borgund Stave Church
landmarks.placement: Actual inland valley location in Lærdal, Norway. Multi-tier timber church and dragon finials are modeled for this site.
